title: Workiz Job to SMS Follow-Up System - AI Replies, Human Approval

sections.label: 1 · A JOB LANDS ON YOUR BOARD
sections.note: The moment Workiz assigns the job to you, this fires. Nobody has to remember to text anyone.

sections.label: 2 · THE FIRST TEXT GOES OUT
sections.note: Written from your own template, filled with this customer's real job details, sent from the Quo number they already know.

sections.label: 3 · THE CUSTOMER TEXTS BACK
sections.note: AI reads the reply and picks from your pre-approved templates. It never writes a message from scratch.

sections.label: 4 · YOUR REP APPROVES BEFORE ANYTHING SENDS
sections.note: The suggestion goes to a person first. Shown here in Slack, but this can just as easily be a Quo internal thread or a text to the rep.

sections.label: 5 · EVERY MESSAGE LOGGED, NOTHING FAILS QUIETLY
sections.note: One row per conversation, plus an alert the moment a step breaks so a customer is never left on read.

input_sample.address: 221 Wellington St W, Toronto, ON M5V 3C7
input_sample.notes: Second floor unit, buzz suite 404. Building has no rear access after 4pm.

first_sms.body: Hi Priya, Marc from Northline Mechanical here. You're booked Thursday Sep 11 between 1 and 3pm at 221 Wellington W for the furnace diagnostic. I'll text when I'm 30 min out. Reply here if anything changes.

output_sample.customer_reply: can we push it to friday morning? nobody is here thursday after 2

ai_read.why: Customer names a different day and a hard constraint on the current window, no pricing or complaint language.

output_sample.suggested_reply: No problem Priya. I have Friday Sep 12, 8-10am or 10am-12pm. Which works better and I'll move the job over?

human_step.edit: added 'I'll confirm with the office and text you back within the hour'

output_sample.if_it_had_failed: Error handler fires, Slack alert names the job id and the step that broke, so nobody is left waiting on a text that never sent.
